name: Palm oil
explanation: Oil pressed from the fruit of the oil palm. It is solid at Indian room temperature, which is why it is common in biscuits, bakery fat and fried snacks.

sources.note: Alias wordings observed in the ingredient statements of imported Indian products.
Written by Prana contributors. Describes what the substance is; contains no health claim and no value copied from a label.

aliases.note: Each alias was seen in at least one imported product.

flags.note: Classification of the substance, not a value copied from a label.
